title: Training Fair Tabular Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.14211v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Tabular Foundation Models (TFMs) have emerged as leading methods for tabular predictive tasks, leveraging in-context learning to predict on new data without task-specific training. Despite the increased use of TFMs in high-stakes decision-making, their fairness properties remain largely unexplored. In this work, we incorporate fairness constraints directly into TFM training, enabling fair predictions in a single forward pass. Our approach addresses two key challenges: limited access to sensitive attributes in training data, and the incompatibility of existing fairness techniques with the in-context learning paradigm. We propose FairTFM, a scalable training strategy based on synthetic fairness tasks and a fairness-aware architecture using a gradient reversal layer, which encourages the model to learn representations invariant to sensitive attributes. translated_title: 训练公平的表格基础模型
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14211v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：表格基础模型（TFMs）已成为表格预测任务的主要方法，利用上下文学习在新数据上进行预测，而无需特定任务的训练。尽管TFMs在高风险决策中的使用日益增多，但其公平性特性在很大程度上仍未得到探索。在这项工作中，我们将公平性约束直接纳入TFM训练，使得在一次前向传播中就能实现公平预测。我们的方法解决了两个关键挑战：训练数据中敏感属性的访问受限，以及现有公平性技术与上下文学习范式的兼容性问题。我们提出了FairTFM，一种基于合成公平任务和公平感知架构的可扩展训练策略，该架构使用梯度反转层，鼓励模型学习对敏感属性不变的表示。在132个公平任务上的实验表明，在保持性能的同时，公平性得到了一致的改善。
tldr: 本文提出FairTFM，通过合成公平任务和梯度反转层架构，在表格基础模型训练中直接嵌入公平约束，实现单次前向传播中的公平预测，并在132个任务上验证了公平性与性能的平衡。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes FairTFM, which embeds fairness constraints directly into tabular foundation model training via synthetic fairness tasks and a gradient reversal layer, enabling fair predictions in a single forward pass and demonstrating consistent fairness improvements across 132 tasks.
